name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present), created a script following the quickstart pattern, and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response was: "¡Hola! That's the most common way to say hello in Spanish. It's friendly, informal, and works at any time of day."
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, which returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I queried the available models endpoint and switched to `accounts/fireworks/models/kimi-k2p6`, which worked and returned a valid chat completion.

env_ready.evidence: Defaulting to user installation because normal site-packages is not writeable
